display.purpose: Major orientation and product identity only.

body.purpose: Dense but readable interface and explanatory copy.

label.purpose: Amounts, metadata, formulas, controls, and provenance.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: True modal and full-screen overlay surfaces only.

motion.name: state-change
motion.purpose: Panels, readouts, and analytical selection changes.

components.name: Registry Button
components.description: Compact editorial action with explicit focus and active states.
components.css: .ds-btn { background: transparent; color: var(--paper, #f4ede2); border: 1px solid var(--rule, #4a3b35); border-radius: 2px; padding: 8px 12px; min-height: 36px; font: 500 10px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: color 120ms cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1), border-color 120ms cubic-bezier(.25,1,.5,1); } .ds-btn:hover { color: var(--red, #c14843); border-color: var(--red, #c14843); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--red, #c14843); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Registry Search
components.description: Transparent search field with a strong rule and red focus state.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--paper, #f4ede2); } .ds-field-label { font: 500 10px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-input { background: transparent; color: inherit; border: 1.5px solid var(--rule, #4a3b35); border-radius: 2px; padding: 9px 14px; font: 400 14px/1.5 'Albert Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: var(--red, #c14843); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px var(--red, #c14843); }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Compact state token for reversible filters and analytical selections.
components.css: .ds-chip { background: transparent; color: var(--red, #c14843); border: 1px solid var(--red, #c14843); border-radius: 999px; padding: 6px 10px; min-height: 32px; font: 500 10px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .06em; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--red, #c14843) 10%, transparent); } .ds-chip:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--red, #c14843); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: View Navigation
components.description: Familiar tabs with a red active rule and restrained inactive states.
components.html: <nav class="ds-nav" aria-label="Views"><button class="ds-tab is-active" aria-current="page">REGISTRY</button><button class="ds-tab">ABOUT</button><button class="ds-tab">PROCESS</button></nav>
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-tab { background: transparent; color: var(--paper-dim, #d6cebe); border: 1.5px solid transparent; border-radius: 2px; padding: 7px 12px; font: 600 12px/1.4 'Albert Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--paper, #f4ede2); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--red, #c14843); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab.is-active { color: var(--paper, #f4ede2); border-color: var(--red, #c14843); }

components.name: Analytical Figure
components.description: Ruled editorial chart container with visible context and an exact readout.
components.css: .ds-figure { margin: 0; padding: 16px 0; border-top: 1px solid var(--rule, #4a3b35); color: var(--paper, #f4ede2); } .ds-figure figcaption { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; gap: 16px; align-items: baseline; } .ds-kicker { color: var(--paper-dim, #d6cebe); font: 500 10px/1.4 'JetBrains Mono', ui-monospace, monospace; letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-chart { height: 96px; margin: 14px 0 10px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule, #4a3b35); background: linear-gradient(to top, color-mix(in oklab, var(--red, #c14843) 18%, transparent), transparent); } .ds-figure p { margin: 0; color: var(--paper-dim, #d6cebe); font: 400 12px/1.5 'Albert Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview:
Sredstva should feel like a carefully edited working desk for public records: warm paper, dark ink, ruled divisions, exact figures, and restrained annotations. It is dense because its users compare evidence repeatedly, but hierarchy and progressive disclosure keep that density legible.

The interface is editorial, rigorous, and direct. It must never drift into a generic SaaS dashboard, a decorative metric-card grid, or a glossy visualization product. Interaction exists to help users investigate and verify, not to make public data feel theatrical.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, tinted neutrals in both themes
One red accent reserved for selection, focus, and consequential actions
Editorial display type paired with a neutral body face and tabular mono labels
Flat, ruled surfaces with depth used only for true overlays
Compact information density with explicit provenance and exact values
Responsive composition rather than a shrunken desktop layout

rules.name: The Red-Pencil Rule
rules.body: Registry red marks a decision or an active state. It is never ambient decoration and should occupy less than roughly ten percent of a screen.

rules.name: The Evidence-Is-Not-Color Rule
rules.body: Every chart color must be paired with a label, value, pattern, or position. Meaning must survive grayscale and common color-vision deficiencies.

rules.name: The Three-Voices Rule
rules.body: Bricolage speaks only for orientation, Albert Sans for reading, and JetBrains Mono for evidence. Never introduce another typographic voice for novelty.

rules.name: The Flat-Ledger Rule
rules.body: If a section can be separated by space and a rule, it must not become a floating card.

dos: Do prioritize comparison and investigation over decoration.
Do keep the registry dense, legible, and predictable for repeated use.
Do distinguish global registry facts from the active filtered scope.
Do connect important numbers to denominators, field coverage, methodology, and source evidence.
Do use progressive disclosure for formulas, caveats, and detailed records.
Do preserve bilingual content, light/dark/auto themes, visible focus, and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't build a generic SaaS dashboard.
Don't use decorative metric-card grids or leaderboard framing.
Don't use glossy data visualizations or gratuitous motion.
Don't conceal provenance, denominators, exact values, or field coverage.
Don't use nested cards, glassmorphism, gradient text, or colored side-stripe accents.
Don't make hover the only way to reveal information or perform an action.
Don't use registry red as ambient decoration or rely on color alone for meaning.
